text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp—while spending the final night
in the camp lodge's lounge—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ummm.
An empty desk would be..."
choice_data_list: Doing your side work again tonight?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, 'sup, 'sup, Trainer! Well, I'm just doing what I can~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Piecework pays you according to how much you finish, after all!
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll help out too, then.
Maybe I'll help out too, then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh. It's fine, really.
You have your own work as a Trainer, right?
choice_data_list: I happened to have some free time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"......Ah. Somehow that look in your eyes
seems even more stubborn than usual."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I had some things about
the race I wanted to ask Trainer about anyway.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Since I'm giving you advice anyway...
If you've got nothing to do, maybe you could help me with my side job?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beside Ines Fujin,
I affix stickers to the designated spots on the envelopes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is quite dexterous.
She swiftly and neatly puts on each sticker,
piling up stacks of envelopes on the table.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer.
I still haven't mastered that new running style yet, have I?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I can tell by how I feel after running. If I keep going like this, I'll end up burning through all my energy before the real race again.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I know I have to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I recall people saying back in her Junior Class days that Ines Fujin's running was a case of 'her legs unable to keep up with her heart.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In other words, it was the same as saying she has "run on pure feeling." It also served as proof that her passion for running was far stronger than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Suppressing those feelings might have been
putting far more of a strain on her than I imagined.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
How do I look through your eyes right now?
What do you think I need?
choice_data_list: If it's too difficult to hold back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! It's a call.
I'll go take it real quick!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Catch! Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, the envelopes...!
Uuugh... sorry! I'll sort those out later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The neatly stacked pile of envelopes from earlier was knocked over by her hand as she rushed out, scattering across the table.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello. Su-chan?
Is Lu-chan with you?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "About what we talked about earlier, your big sis is absolutely NOT backing down on this!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want you all to chase your dreams too.
And I will definitely make sure you have the environment to do so.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...No. No, that's not it!
It's okay, Big Sis won't stop running!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis won't let your support go to waste,
especially when you all pushed yourselves so hard for me."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Still, I won't let you quit either. If you're short on help, I'll secure the funds to hire more people!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No matter what Mom and Dad say,
I'll definitely make it work!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"If you're still worried,
just watch the Kikuka Sho! Big Sis won't end up
like she did at the Derby—"
